prompt.zh-TW: 小山咖啡的 ROA（Excel 口徑）從去年的 {{percent:vars.last}} 降到今年的 {{percent:vars.now}}，本期淨利和去年一樣。年底發生了什麼事，最能解釋這個變化？
prompt.en: Hillside Coffee’s ROA (Excel basis) fell from {{percent:vars.last}} last year to {{percent:vars.now}} this year, with profit for the period the same as last year. What happened at year end that best explains the change?

text.zh-TW: 年底用借款買了一台很貴的烘豆機
text.en: It bought a very expensive roasting machine with a loan at year end

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。淨利沒變，ROA 減半，表示分母的資產總計差不多變成兩倍；新買的設備還沒開始貢獻利益。
feedback.en: That’s right. With profit unchanged and ROA halved, total assets in the denominator roughly doubled; the new machine has not yet started contributing to profit.

text.zh-TW: 今年咖啡賣得比較少，生意變差了
text.en: It sold less coffee this year, so business got worse

feedback.zh-TW: 你從獲利去想，很直覺。不過題目說本期淨利和去年一樣，分子沒變；變的只能是分母的資產。
feedback.en: Thinking of profit first is intuitive. But profit for the period is the same as last year, so the numerator did not change; only the assets in the denominator can have moved.

text.zh-TW: 年底股東把一部分資金領回去
text.en: At year end the shareholders withdrew part of their money

feedback.zh-TW: 股東領走現金會讓資產與權益一起變小；淨利不變時，ROA 反而會上升，不是下降。
feedback.en: A withdrawal by shareholders shrinks assets and equity together; with profit unchanged, ROA would rise rather than fall.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_r0a5t3kq}}＝本期淨利 ÷ {{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}。分子不變、比率減半，分母大約變成兩倍：{{option:o_h3j1}}。{{option:o_7g55}}與前提矛盾，{{option:o_gzre}}的方向相反。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_r0a5t3kq}} = profit for the period ÷ {{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}. With the numerator unchanged and the ratio halved, the denominator roughly doubled: {{option:o_h3j1}}. {{option:o_7g55}} contradicts the premise, and {{option:o_gzre}} would push the ratio the other way.
